motivation: Merianieae reached an outcome-unopened schema HOLD because the target colour field was numeric-coded under a literal-colour hierarchy contract.

Erysimum reached an outcome-unopened source-transport HOLD despite a publication-defined three-state colour trait because its exact Dryad package is currently not publicly transportable through an identity-verifiable route.
Future candidate selection should therefore gate on currently recoverable exact bytes before committing to phenotype semantics or analysis.

search_budget.selection_rule: Evaluate candidates in the order they are discovered under the frozen metadata/source criteria; stop at the first candidate that passes every hard admission criterion.
search_budget.if_none_pass: STOP_NO_SOURCE_COMPLETE_REPLACEMENT; do not continue open-ended candidate fishing until a new dataset is released or a blocked exact source becomes recoverable.
search_budget.candidate_switch_after_admission: Only source/schema/crosswalk/opportunity/informativeness HOLD may reopen this source-first screen. A biological PASS or FAIL ends replacement searching.

hard_admission_criteria.publication_level_colour_set_must_includ: white plus at least two distinct non-white categories, or an equivalently explicit source-defined nested colour hierarchy frozen before rows
hard_admission_criteria.exact_bytes_identity_verifiable: repository checksum/digest or repository-version exact object identity plus deterministic byte hash frozen at recovery

preferred_source_priority: GitHub release or tagged repository files plus immutable commit/blob identity
OSF public files with stable identifiers/checksums
Dryad only when exact file bytes are currently downloadable without authentication or anti-bot transport failure
metadata_only_operations_allowed: article abstract/methods and reported species count
repository landing page and file list
README and author code needed to identify trait/tree objects or decode schema, provided species-level colour rows are not opened
tree object metadata such as tip count and presence of branch lengths without emitting tip labels
forbidden_during_screen: global colour phylogenetic signal computed by CHUN
ranking candidates by published or newly computed CHUN-like outcome
changing the source criteria after a candidate fails them
prospective_sequence_after_admission: freeze exact trait/tree identities and schema
